samples.xml_description:
<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Indicates if the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Indicates if a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Indicates if the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Indicates if an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD" value="6'b100000">Addition operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU" value="6'b100001">Unsigned Addition operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB" value="6'b100010">Subtraction operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU" value="6'b100011">Unsigned Subtraction operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND" value="6'b100100">Bitwise AND operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR" value="6'b100101">Bitwise OR operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR" value="6'b100110">Bitwise XOR operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR" value="6'b100111">Bitwise NOR operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT" value="6'b101010">Set Less Than operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU" value="6'b101011">Unsigned Set Less Than operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL" value="6'b000000">Logical Shift Left operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL" value="6'b000010">Logical Shift Right operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA" value="6'b000011">Arithmetic Shift Right operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV" value="6'b000100">Variable Logical Shift Left operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV" value="6'b000110">Variable Logical Shift Right operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV" value="6'b000111">Variable Arithmetic Shift Right operation.</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI" value="6'b001111">Load Upper Immediate operation.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to store the result of the operation.</reg>
        <assign id="flag" value="((aluc == SLT || aluc == SLTU) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0)">Flag is set based on the operation being SLT or SLTU.</assign>
        <always_comb>
            case(aluc)
                ADD: res <= $signed(a) + $signed(b);
                ADDU: res <= a + b;
                SUB: res <= $signed(a) - $signed(b);
                SUBU: res <= a - b;
                AND: res <= a & b;
                OR: res <= a | b;
                XOR: res <= a ^ b;
                NOR: res <= ~(a | b);
                SLT: res <= ($signed(a) < $signed(b)) ? 1 : 0;
                SLTU: res <= (a < b) ? 1 : 0;
                SLL: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRL: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRA: res <= $signed(b) >>> a[4:0];
                SLLV: res <= b << a[4:0];
                SRLV: res <= b >> a[4:0];
                SRAV: res <= $signed(b) >>> a[4:0];
                LUI: res <= {a[15:0], 16'h0};
                default: res <= 32'hzzzzzzzz;
            endcase
        </always_comb>
        <assign id="r" value="res[31:0]">Assigns the lower 32 bits of the register to the output.</assign>
        <assign id="zero" value="(res == 32'h00000000) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0">Determines if the result is zero.</assign>
        <assign id="carry" value="res[32]">Determines if there is a carry.</assign>
        <assign id="negative" value="res[31]">Determines if the result is negative.</assign>
        <assign id="overflow" value="res[32]">Determines if there is an overflow.</assign>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Describes the behavior of the ALU based on the control signals and inputs.</implementation>
</module>
